name: video-frame-expedition
description: Edit in DaVinci Resolve with an AI assistant that knows what each shot contains: the MCP server of Video Frame Expedition for DaVinci Resolve (a local application) and a skill to edit with it. Requires Video Frame Expedition for DaVinci Resolve 1.1.1 or newer.

app_url.title: Application address
app_url.description: MCP address of Video Frame Expedition. Keep the default when the application runs on this computer; otherwise its address on your local network or Tailscale, for instance http://100.64.12.34:8765/mcp.

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Only for an application on another computer: the token shown on its Connections page. Leave it empty on the application's own computer, where no token is asked.
